jobs.title: Chief Development Officer
jobs.description:
**Summary**

The Chief Development Officer serves as a fundraising visionary, manages activities relating to the analysis, planning, execution, control, and evaluation of fundraising and selected public relations programs; provides leadership and works with and through the Board of Directors and appropriate committees for all fundraising programs, including communications and public relations programs that are designed to enhance and support the overall mission of the Company.

**Essential Functions**

Fundraising & Philanthropic Development:

* Evaluate and enhance the overall development program to maximize fundraising effectiveness.
* Develop and implement annual and long-range fundraising strategies, goals, and objectives.
* Identify, cultivate, and solicit major gift prospects.
* Secure support through annual giving, major gifts, planned giving, corporate partnerships, and foundation grants.
* Personally engage in donor cultivation and solicitation efforts in partnership with the President/CEO, Board of Directors, and key stakeholders.
* Lead capital campaigns for facility improvements, acquisitions, and endowment growth.

Community Engagement & Relationship Building:

* Expand and diversify support throughout Los Angeles County and surrounding communities.
* Build and maintain meaningful relationships with donors, community partners, corporations, foundations, and long-time supporters.
* Collaborate with program leaders and administrators to align fundraising initiatives with organizational priorities.
* Present the organization’s mission, impact, and funding needs to a wide range of stakeholders.

Volunteer Leadership:

* Design and oversee volunteer engagement strategies that support organizational goals.
* Recruit, train, motivate, and manage volunteers to strengthen fundraising and community outreach efforts.
* Expand and enhance the organization's volunteer network and ambassador program.
* Provide support to the Board Development Committee and volunteer leadership as necessary.

Marketing, Communications & Public Relations:

* Direct media relations and promote the organization through print, television, radio, and digital channels.
* Oversee the development of key communication materials, including newsletters, annual reports, brochures, and fundraising campaigns.
* Ensure all communications align with the organization's mission, values, and strategic objectives.

Grants & Resource Development:

* Lead the grant development and management process from prospect identification through reporting and compliance.
* Build and maintain relationships with funding organizations and philanthropic foundations.
* Ensure grant funds are administered and utilized in accordance with funding requirements.

Executive Leadership & Strategic Planning:

* Serve as a key member of the executive leadership team, helping advance the organization's mission and growth objectives.
* Develop innovative strategies to strengthen philanthropic support and organizational sustainability.
* Perform other leadership responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Certified Fund-Raising Executive (CFRE) preferred
* Excellent working knowledge of fund development practices in a non-profit, preferably including experience with social services or children's organizations
* Able to personally solicit individuals, corporations, and foundations
* Very strong oral and written communication skills, with ability to relate to the public, coupled with very strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate others
* Working knowledge of how to develop long-term relationships with community organizations, representatives of companies, and others that might provide financial or other support
* Effective computer skills, including MS Word, Excel and fundraising software
* Financial skills sufficient to develop and monitor an annual budget
* Supervisory skills to manage a small staff and establish objectives and set performance standards
* Demonstrated skills in project management, event planning and organization
* Must fulfill all requirements of employment, including clearance of all required background records (e.g. Department of Justice, Child Abuse, California Community Care Licensing, County Sanction List, etc.), professional and physical examination, and drug testing

**Physical Requirements**

In the course of performing this in-person job, the incumbent must be able to lift at least 40 lbs. Frequent sitting, twisting, typing, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasional walking, driving, standing, bending, grasping, pulling, pushing, and reaching.

jobs.title: Head of Card Customer Analytics & AI Enablement-Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of analytics by designing and implementing solutions that empower smarter, faster decisions. This is a senior leadership role within JPMorganChase's Card business that requires technical depth in AI/ML, the ability to translate between business strategy and technical execution, and a track record of building high-performing analytics teams.

As the Head of Card Customer Analytics & AI Enablement leading the Card Customer & Strategic Analytics team, you'll lead a group of analytics leaders, data scientists, and analysts responsible for delivering AI and analytics solutions that shape product strategy, customer experience, and competitive positioning across the Card portfolio. Your role will span three core areas: setting AI and analytical direction across multiple business domains, serving as the bridge between senior business stakeholders and technical teams, and building organizational capability through talent development, inclusive culture, and operational excellence.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Define and drive the AI and analytics strategy for Card D&A, identifying high-value opportunities for generative AI, agentic AI, and advanced analytics to create competitive advantage
* Stay current on emerging AI/ML techniques and evaluate new capabilities, tools, and vendor offerings for practical application in the Card business
* Partner with Data, Product, Technology, Risk, and Finance to deliver AI and ML solutions from ideation through production deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, responsible, and aligned to business needs
* Lead analytics supporting customer experience, benefits, product design, portfolio performance, and pricing and targeting strategies
* Drive measurement frameworks, experimentation (including A/B testing and causal inference), and personalization strategies that improve customer experience and benefits utilization
* Build and lead competitive intelligence capabilities that monitor market trends, competitor positioning, and industry benchmarks, partnering with external vendors and synthesizing internal and external data to give senior leaders a clear view of the competitive landscape
* Deliver forward-looking analyses that inform strategic planning and product roadmap decisions
* Serve as the connective tissue between business strategy and technical execution translating business problems into analytical frameworks and translating model outputs into executive-ready recommendations
* Define analytical priorities with senior stakeholders, interpret results, and drive data-informed decisions across product, marketing, and servicing strategies
* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi-layered team of analytics leaders, data scientists, and analysts, setting clear goals and performance expectations and providing ongoing coaching across all levels
* Champion a culture of innovation, intellectual rigor, inclusion, and collaborative problem-solving across the broader Card Data & Analytics organization

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Master's or PhD in a quantitative field and 10+ years of progressive analytics experience
* Senior leadership experience managing and developing multi-disciplinary analytics teams, including managers and individual contributors with strong coaching, org design, and talent development skills
* Strong technical foundation in AI/ML, including experience evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, guiding architecture decisions, and moving solutions from prototype to production
* Working knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI patterns, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic frameworks, with the ability to assess where they add value vs. simpler approaches
* Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences, with a track record of influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners
* Experience scoping and prioritizing a portfolio of analytical workstreams across multiple business domains in a large enterprise environment
* Proficiency in Python and/or R, and experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks
* Experience with causal inference, A/B testing, and experimentation frameworks at scale

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience in Card, consumer lending, or payments analytics, including familiarity with installment products, credit risk, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience building or leading competitive intelligence functions using alternative data, market data, or external benchmarking
* Familiarity with data architecture concepts (ingestion, modeling, governance, quality) and MLOps/observability practices
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles, model governance, and regulatory considerations in financial services
* Experience enabling analytics adoption through change management, self-service tooling, or organizational enablement
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods and modern product practices

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
**Company:** BGW Creative Marketing  
**Position Type:** Full-Time / Contracted Independent Director  
**Location:** Remote (Candidates must reside within the Greater New York City Metropolitan Area)  
**Compensation Model:** Full Performance-Based Commission Override + Equity Profit-Share Split

POSITION EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW

BGW Creative Marketing is a premier, high-velocity digital marketing consultancy, enterprise media-buying firm, and corporate credit solutions agency. We specialize in advising visionary brand leaders on global market expansion, digital presence optimization, personal and business credit restoration, and high-impact physical advertising placements—including Times Square billboards and metropolitan transit media networks. We are currently seeking a high-caliber, fiercely disciplined, and commercially astute Operations Manager / Chief Operating Officer (COO) to command our remote regional infrastructure. Reporting directly to the principal Attending Owner on a weekly governance schedule, the incoming COO will assume absolute executive control over daily business operations, outbound business development management, and remote team workflows. This elite role is strictly reserved for an energetic leader with an expert command of linear corporate strategy, process improvement, and data-driven operational analysis.

CORE ADMINISTRATIVE & MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Outbound Workforce Construction:** Recruit, build, and actively supervise an elite team of commission-based Sales Representatives to systematically capture enterprise brand accounts across all New York City boroughs.
* **Specialist Procurement & Onboarding:** Source, vet, and onboard certified remote Credit Processing Agents and performance-based Capital Advisors to fulfill complex client financial optimization tracks.
* **Fulfillment Portfolio Oversight:** Manage independent graphic designers, copywriters, and web developers on a per-project contract baseline, ensuring all corporate branding bundles are delivered on scope and within strict deadlines.
* **Financial Control & Optimization:** Review daily account pipelines, manage project management parameters, optimize resource allocation, and perform rigorous profit and loss analysis to continuously maximize corporate net margins.
* **Data-Driven Reporting:** Implement advanced data-driven decision-making frameworks to track team efficiency and deliver concise weekly metric updates to ownership.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

* **Proven Executive Competency:** Demonstrated experience in operational management, business development management, program management, or agency scaling operations.
* **Financial & Analytical Acumen:** Advanced expertise in budget management, forecasting, profit/loss analysis, and operational analysis metrics.
* **Elite Communication Standards:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven track record of engaging effectively with high-level stakeholders, executives, and cross-functional teams.
* **Strategic Execution Management:** A linear, strategic thinker with a passionate commitment to corporate excellence, process optimization, and large-scale organizational change management.
* **Geographic Proximity:** Must be locally based within the New York City metropolitan area to ensure immediate capability to coordinate face-to-face with corporate clients and evaluate physical media buying locations.

COMPENSATION FRAMEWORK & PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

To maximize operational leverage and align executive incentives directly with corporate revenue milestones, this position is structured exclusively on a full performance-based commission and profit-share model. There is absolute zero fixed flat base salary or fixed hourly wage attached to this role.The Chief Operating Officer will receive an exceptional commission override on all collective agency sales alongside an attractive net profit-share split of total cleared monthly business revenue. Total earnings are completely uncapped and directly tied to your operational velocity and team performance metrics. Join BGW Creative Marketing to drive transformative solutions, shape the future of local and global brand marketing, and bridge vision with flawless execution!

Pay: $101,000.00 - $123,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Executive Director of Operations
jobs.description:
About The Mead Institute

The Mead Institute exists to build mead into a durable, respected, 1,000-year industry. We do this by developing rigorous, superior standards for tasting, quality, and instruction, and by disseminating those standards through professional channels to producers, employees, consumers, retailers, distributors, and the media. We are the connective tissue between mead craft and mead commerce — setting the bar for what “quality mead” means and making sure everyone in the value chain, from meadmaker to consumer, understands and upholds it.

Position Summary

The Executive Director (ED) is the chief executive of The Mead Institute, responsible for translating the organization's long-horizon mission into an operating reality: standards that are credible, education that is trusted, and a professional network that keeps growing. The ED leads strategy, fundraising, operations, and external representation, and serves as the public face of the organization to the mead industry, media, and allied trade groups. This is a builder's role. The ED will professionalize a young field — creating structures (certifications, tasting protocols, curricula, industry partnerships) that don't yet fully exist and shepherding them toward durable, widely adopted standards.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

* Set and drive a multi-year strategic plan that advances the Institute's mission of establishing mead as a permanent, respected beverage category
* Translate the “1,000-year industry” mission into concrete annual goals, programs, and metrics
* Monitor trends in mead production, the broader beverage-alcohol industry, and adjacent trade organizations (wine, beer, cider, spirits) to keep the Institute's standards current and credible

Standards Development & Quality Programs

* Oversee the development, maintenance, and periodic revision of tasting standards, quality benchmarks, and style/category definitions for mead
* Build and manage certification or accreditation programs (e.g., judge certification, quality seals, meadmaker credentials)
* Convene panels of meadmakers, sensory experts, and industry veterans to steward standards development with technical rigor and broad buy-in
* Ensure standards are documented, defensible, and adaptable as the category matures

Education & Instruction

* Design and oversee curricula and instructional programs for meadmakers, judges, retailers, distributors, and consumers
* Develop training materials, courses, workshops, and certification pathways
* Build relationships with culinary schools, beverage programs, and trade associations to embed mead education into existing pipelines

Dissemination & Industry Relations

* Build and manage channels that carry the Institute's standards to every link in the chain: producers, retail buyers, distributors, hospitality staff, and media
* Cultivate relationships with trade press, beverage journalists, and influencers to shape accurate public narratives about mead
* Represent the Institute at industry conferences, competitions, trade shows, and public events
* Develop partnerships with distributor associations, retail trade groups, and hospitality organizations to embed mead standards into their practices

Organizational Leadership & Operations

* Serve as chief administrative officer: manage staff, contractors, and volunteer committees
* Build and manage the annual budget in partnership with the Board and Treasurer
* Ensure legal, financial, and regulatory compliance as a 501(c)(3), including filings, governance policies, and reporting
* Implement systems and infrastructure (CRM, learning management, communications tools) to scale programs efficiently

Fundraising & Revenue Development

* Lead fundraising strategy: individual donors, foundation grants, corporate sponsorships, and membership or certification fees
* Cultivate relationships with mead producers, beverage-industry companies, and allied trade organizations as funding partners
* Explore and develop earned-revenue streams (certification fees, event revenue, licensing of standards/curricula) to build long-term financial sustainability

Board Governance

* Work closely with the Board of Directors on governance, strategic direction, and policy
* Provide regular reporting on programmatic, financial, and organizational performance
* Support Board recruitment, onboarding, and committee structures

Qualifications

Required

* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience, including nonprofit management, trade association leadership, or beverage/hospitality industry leadership
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling programs, standards, or certifications from an early stage
* Strong fundraising track record (grants, donors, sponsorships, investments or earned revenue)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable as a public spokesperson and media representative
* Budget and operations management experience
* Ability to travel regularly for events, conferences, and partner meetings

Strongly Preferred

* Direct experience in mead, wine, beer, cider, or spirits — production, sensory evaluation, judging, retail, and/or distribution. All 5 ideal.
* Existing relationships within the beverage-alcohol trade, hospitality, or trade media
* Experience with nonprofit governance and 501(c)(3) compliance
* Familiarity with sensory science, tasting protocols, or quality certification systems
* Advanced credential in a relevant field (business, hospitality, food science, or beverage studies) or equivalent industry experience

Personal Attributes

* A long-term builder's mindset — comfortable pursuing a mission measured in decades, not quarters
* High personal credibility with both craft producers and commercial industry players
* Diplomatic, coalition-building style suited to convening stakeholders with different interests
* Entrepreneurial and resourceful, able to operate with lean staff and resources

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Help Build the Future of Christ-Centered Recovery

Renew Clinic is seeking a mission-driven leader to provide organizational leadership while helping grow the relationships, resources, and partnerships necessary to expand our impact.

The Director of Operations & Community Development will oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of Renew Clinic while leading fundraising, grant development, community partnerships, church engagement, and organizational growth.

What You'll Do

* Lead day-to-day organizational operations and administration.
* Implement the strategic direction established by the Board of Directors.
* Develop and manage organizational budgets and financial processes.
* Lead fundraising and grant-development efforts.
* Build relationships with churches, businesses, donors, foundations, healthcare providers, and community organizations.
* Oversee administrative staff and organizational systems.
* Support human resources, facilities, technology, and risk management.
* Coordinate organizational reporting, compliance, and recordkeeping.
* Represent Renew Clinic throughout the community.
* Prepare regular reports and recommendations for the Board.
* Help develop and implement short- and long-term organizational plans.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a mature, organized, relational leader who combines strong administrative skills with a genuine passion for helping individuals and families affected by addiction.

Preferred qualifications include:

* Bachelor's degree in business, nonprofit management, healthcare administration, communications, public administration, or a related field.
* Three to five years of leadership, management, nonprofit, healthcare, ministry, or community-development experience.
* Experience with fundraising, grants, donor development, or community partnerships.
* Experience managing budgets and supervising staff.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the Board, clinical leadership, staff, volunteers, and community partners.
* Commitment to Renew Clinic's Christian mission and values.

A Critical Distinction

This is an administrative and organizational leadership position. The Director of Operations & Community Development does not provide clinical services or make clinical treatment decisions unless separately licensed and authorized to do so.

Why Renew Clinic?

Renew Clinic exists to provide Christ-centered support and recovery services to individuals and families affected by addiction. This is an opportunity to help strengthen the organization, expand community partnerships, increase resources, and build a sustainable foundation for future growth.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Director of Philanthropy (Development)
jobs.description:
Director of Fund Development

ASAP Philadelphia (After School Activities Partnerships)  
Center City Philadelphia (near City Hall)

Salary: $75,000 – $85,000, with a salary review at six months and potential for a performance bonus  
Start Date: As soon as possible, ideally in November

**About ASAP**

For 25 years, ASAP has provided a safe, enriching learning environment for Philadelphia's young people after school through chess, debate, drama, and Scrabble. Depending on the year, we reach 3,000 to 5,000 students across the city, in partnership with the City of Philadelphia, the School District of Philadelphia, and leading corporate and healthcare institutions.

As we approach our 25th anniversary, we are launching an ambitious 10-year strategic plan to serve thousands more young people each year, and to serve them more deeply. Reaching that goal means building a fundraising effort to match. This is a year of great opportunity: we are rebuilding our fundraising from the ground up, re-engaging past supporters, cultivating new ones, and creating the diversified revenue base that will power our next 25 years. We are looking for an exceptional fundraising leader to help lead that work.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial fundraiser to drive the growth of ASAP. This is a frontline role: you will be in the office, out in the community, and on the phone, finding new donors, building relationships, and securing the support that fuels our programs. You will work as a true thought partner to the Executive Director and program staff, and your work will be central to strengthening our financial foundation and determining how many children we can reach in the decade ahead. As ASAP grows, so will the department you build.

**What Matters Most in This Role**

* You make the ask. You thrive on getting out there, finding new individual and corporate donors, and building genuine relationships. And when the moment comes, you make the ask, clearly and confidently, every time. You don't have to love it, but you never shy away from it.
* You lead the whole team in fundraising. You build a culture of philanthropy across ASAP and make sure everyone involved, including the Executive Director, program directors, and Board, knows their role and their next step. That includes managing the Executive Director's fundraising priorities: who to call, who to meet with, and what comes first.
* You pursue goals relentlessly. You pick up the phone, send the email, follow up, and follow up again. You set ambitious funding targets and you meet them.
* You dig in. As ASAP's lead fundraising professional, you set strategy and lead the effort, and you're comfortable handling the hands-on work that comes with a growing organization, from sending our own letters to ordering our own supplies. While we currently manage our own administrative work, we expect to add administrative support for fundraising as our team grows, and volunteers are available to help.
* You are a master of prioritization. You thrive when juggling 10 to 15 priorities at once. You know what matters most today, manage your time with discipline, and keep everything moving.
* You are a thought partner. Regular collaboration with the Executive Director and program staff is central to this job, not an interruption from it. You learn our programs deeply so you can tell our story, understand our needs, and drive our growth.
* You are hungry to grow. You want to grow the organization, grow the budget, and grow your own career along with them.
* The kids are your bottom line. You care deeply about the young people we serve, and that commitment drives everything you do.

**What You'll Do**

Fund Development Leadership

* Working alongside the Executive Director, build a comprehensive, sustainable fund development program, including systems, processes, and a multi-year revenue strategy
* Working alongside the Executive Director, set annual revenue goals, then own them, track progress, and report results to the Executive Director and Board
* Create and oversee all fundraising campaigns, from annual appeals to special campaigns
* Lead regular fundraising meetings with the Executive Director to set priorities, identify which donors to call and meet with, and prepare for each conversation
* Build a culture of philanthropy throughout ASAP, ensuring program directors, staff, and Board members understand and carry out their roles in fundraising
* Partner with the Board to strengthen its fundraising role and engagement
* Coordinate volunteers who support development activities

Individual and Corporate Fundraising

new_jobs.title: Chief Development Officer

new_jobs.title: Head of Card Customer Analytics & AI Enablement-Executive Director

new_jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
new_jobs.description:
**Company:** BGW Creative Marketing  
**Position Type:** Full-Time / Contracted Independent Director  
**Location:** Remote (Candidates must reside within the Greater New York City Metropolitan Area)  
**Compensation Model:** Full Performance-Based Commission Override + Equity Profit-Share Split

POSITION EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW

BGW Creative Marketing is a premier, high-velocity digital marketing consultancy, enterprise media-buying firm, and corporate credit solutions agency. We specialize in advising visionary brand leaders on global market expansion, digital presence optimization, personal and business credit restoration, and high-impact physical advertising placements—including Times Square billboards and metropolitan transit media networks. We are currently seeking a high-caliber, fiercely disciplined, and commercially astute Operations Manager / Chief Operating Officer (COO) to command our remote regional infrastructure. Reporting directly to the principal Attending Owner on a weekly governance schedule, the incoming COO will assume absolute executive control over daily business operations, outbound business development management, and remote team workflows. This elite role is strictly reserved for an energetic leader with an expert command of linear corporate strategy, process improvement, and data-driven operational analysis.

CORE ADMINISTRATIVE & MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Outbound Workforce Construction:** Recruit, build, and actively supervise an elite team of commission-based Sales Representatives to systematically capture enterprise brand accounts across all New York City boroughs.
* **Specialist Procurement & Onboarding:** Source, vet, and onboard certified remote Credit Processing Agents and performance-based Capital Advisors to fulfill complex client financial optimization tracks.
* **Fulfillment Portfolio Oversight:** Manage independent graphic designers, copywriters, and web developers on a per-project contract baseline, ensuring all corporate branding bundles are delivered on scope and within strict deadlines.
* **Financial Control & Optimization:** Review daily account pipelines, manage project management parameters, optimize resource allocation, and perform rigorous profit and loss analysis to continuously maximize corporate net margins.
* **Data-Driven Reporting:** Implement advanced data-driven decision-making frameworks to track team efficiency and deliver concise weekly metric updates to ownership.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

* **Proven Executive Competency:** Demonstrated experience in operational management, business development management, program management, or agency scaling operations.
* **Financial & Analytical Acumen:** Advanced expertise in budget management, forecasting, profit/loss analysis, and operational analysis metrics.
* **Elite Communication Standards:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven track record of engaging effectively with high-level stakeholders, executives, and cross-functional teams.
* **Strategic Execution Management:** A linear, strategic thinker with a passionate commitment to corporate excellence, process optimization, and large-scale organizational change management.
* **Geographic Proximity:** Must be locally based within the New York City metropolitan area to ensure immediate capability to coordinate face-to-face with corporate clients and evaluate physical media buying locations.

COMPENSATION FRAMEWORK & PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

To maximize operational leverage and align executive incentives directly with corporate revenue milestones, this position is structured exclusively on a full performance-based commission and profit-share model. There is absolute zero fixed flat base salary or fixed hourly wage attached to this role.The Chief Operating Officer will receive an exceptional commission override on all collective agency sales alongside an attractive net profit-share split of total cleared monthly business revenue. Total earnings are completely uncapped and directly tied to your operational velocity and team performance metrics. Join BGW Creative Marketing to drive transformative solutions, shape the future of local and global brand marketing, and bridge vision with flawless execution!

Pay: $101,000.00 - $123,000.00 per year

* Professional development assistance

new_jobs.description:

Help Build the Future of Christ-Centered Recovery

Renew Clinic is seeking a mission-driven leader to provide organizational leadership while helping grow the relationships, resources, and partnerships necessary to expand our impact.

The Director of Operations & Community Development will oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of Renew Clinic while leading fundraising, grant development, community partnerships, church engagement, and organizational growth.

What You'll Do

* Lead day-to-day organizational operations and administration.
* Implement the strategic direction established by the Board of Directors.
* Develop and manage organizational budgets and financial processes.
* Lead fundraising and grant-development efforts.
* Build relationships with churches, businesses, donors, foundations, healthcare providers, and community organizations.
* Oversee administrative staff and organizational systems.
* Support human resources, facilities, technology, and risk management.
* Coordinate organizational reporting, compliance, and recordkeeping.
* Represent Renew Clinic throughout the community.
* Prepare regular reports and recommendations for the Board.
* Help develop and implement short- and long-term organizational plans.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a mature, organized, relational leader who combines strong administrative skills with a genuine passion for helping individuals and families affected by addiction.

* Bachelor's degree in business, nonprofit management, healthcare administration, communications, public administration, or a related field.
* Three to five years of leadership, management, nonprofit, healthcare, ministry, or community-development experience.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
